propositions: Raw scan of ordered `*-REVIEW_RESULT.json` and `*-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json` event files must read all records by schema-guarded kind (plan_review_result_v2, completion_verifier_pass_v1, gate_error_v1) and not rely on reducer helpers that filter or return only the latest record.

LLM cost proxy and latency derivations read `llm_calls` and latency fields exclusively from `REVIEW_RESULT.metrics` blocks; COMPLETION_VERDICT records carry no metrics and must not be queried for cost data.

Cost-per-accepted-change equals the sum of `REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls` divided by the count of `completion_verifier_pass_v1` records (accepted closes); when zero accepted closes exist, the metric returns None instead of raising ZeroDivisionError.

First-pass verification is the fraction of tickets whose earliest (oldest-first by filename order) `COMPLETION_VERDICT` record is a `completion_verifier_pass_v1`, indicating passage on the first close-verification attempt.

Environment diagnosis intervals pair each `gate_error_v1` ERROR record with the next PASS record for the same gate (matching the ERROR's `gate` field against plan_review/code_review/completion); the interval is PASS timestamp minus ERROR timestamp; an ERROR with no following same-gate PASS represents an open (unclosed) diagnosis interval.

All metrics register into `src/rebar/metrics/registry.py` with `source="sidecar"` and `is_authoritative("sidecar") == True`, representing high-confidence read-only derivations over persisted sidecar data.
